$comment: Golden cases for the classic-native -> formplus conversion (`formplus:migrate-openform --classic`, DESIGN.md 8, SEC-DESIGN.md 8.2). Canonical: fORM- packages/registry/src/profiles/dms-v1/__fixtures__/. Byte-identical copy: dms-api tests/Fixtures/formplus/. Modelled on openform-to-dms-v1.fixtures.json. A classic element is already in the dms-v1 dialect, so json_data is kept byte for byte: `expected.element` equals `input`, `expected.masterField.properties` equals the stored properties (all 12 keys of the legacy writer, MasterService::processFormBuilderFields, survive). The one normalisation is `normalisations`: layout elements without a column are dropped and reported. Columns of _dynamic_master_* and record values are never touched. Consumers: dms-api ClassicConversionTest (plan and apply), fORM- registry round-trip test (load + save of every case keeps every key).
normalisations: layout elements (header, paragraph, linebreak) are dropped from json_data and listed under dropped; nothing else changes
blockingRules: duplicate_name: two kept elements whose trimmed names match case-insensitively
empty_name: a kept element whose trimmed name and master field name are both empty
unsupported_element: a type outside the 7 that owns a master_fields column and has no read-only legacy mapping
workflow_bound: rows in master_workflow_events unless --include-workflow-bound and MasterWorkflowStructuralGuard reports no structural change
workflow_unavailable: workflow integration enabled and wf-api unreachable

elementCases.name: textinput-primary
elementCases.note: classic writes both primary and is_primary; fORM- models primary and keeps is_primary in x-dms, so the pair round-trips

elementCases.name: dropdown-with-advanced-rules
elementCases.note: advanced_rules is kept byte for byte and rides in x-dms; the dependent options are still served by the legacy routes

elementCases.name: dropdown-dependent-child
elementCases.note: parent_field_id is the read-only remote parent the record renderers use; it is not linkedTo

elementCases.name: hidden-and-secret-properties-kept
elementCases.note: is_hidden, is_secret and unique live only in master_fields.properties: they survive byte for byte (C5), and the element is unchanged

masterCases.name: layout-elements-dropped
masterCases.note: header, paragraph and linebreak own no column and carry no values; dropping them is the one normalisation (as the OpenForm converter drops layout blocks) and they are listed in the report

masterCases.name: unsupported-element-owning-a-column-blocked
masterCases.note: an element outside the 7 types that owns a master_fields column and has no read-only legacy mapping (C7)

masterCases.name: workflow-bound-blocked
masterCases.note: master_workflow_events has a row: blocked unless --include-workflow-bound and the structural guard reports no change

masterCases.name: workflow-unavailable-blocked
masterCases.note: never assumed safe when wf-api is unreachable
